rows.grounds: fused compound naming puja items; ornaments also included in the compound

items.question: What additional upacara items complete the sixteen-service worship of the goddess?
premises: Sixteen upacaras are used for worship.
The verse names madhuparka acamana snana vasana abharana.
Ca adds these items to the prior list.
items.inference: These items belong among the sixteen upacaras offered to the goddess.
uncertainties: The exact grammatical case of the compound is not fully certain.
Whether madhuparka counts as one item or three is ambiguous.
items.plain_english: And honey-curd water, rinsing, bathing, clothes, and ornaments.
